title: Pelayo Solage | KEY.co
description_expanded: Pelayo Solage is an exceptional coastal retreat tucked within the coveted Gulf Shore Manor community of Seagrove Beach, a rare enclave along 30A with deeded access to over a mile of pristine, uninterrupted shoreline. Just a short stroll from the emerald waters and sugar-white sands, the home offers a seamless blend of timeless architecture and modern coastal luxury. With more than 4,300 square feet of thoughtfully designed interior space and an additional 1,500 square feet of terraces and balconies, the residence provides ample room to relax, entertain, and gather. Inside, wide-plank hardwood floors, artisan tile, and a chef’s kitchen outfitted with Viking appliances create an atmosphere of refined comfort, while spa-inspired bathrooms offer serene, high-end finishes that elevate every stay. Outdoor living at Pelayo Solage feels like a private resort experience. A heated pool and spa anchor the beautifully designed backyard, surrounded by inviting lounge seating, a fire pit, and expansive terraces that capture sweeping coastal views—perfect for sunset cocktails or quiet evenings under the stars. A dedicated game and media room adds another welcoming space for movie nights and family gatherings, while a six-seater low-speed vehicle and complimentary bikes make exploring 30A effortless. From the charm of nearby Seaside to scenic bike paths and beloved beachside cafés, this remarkable home delivers an inspiring blend of elegance, comfort, and relaxed coastal living.
